testPlan.title: farm track 101: lock, clear, build, clear again

test.title: The game loaded this build
test.hint: Ticks itself: the running build is the one this plan was packed with.

test.title: Junction 101 clears
test.passLog: one shared point of %d+ two%-way tracks
test.hint: Lock 101 and clear it with through roads kept: the log says it is one shared point (ticks itself), the south track comes off the point (about 5 points go) and the west to north-east track stays whole. The card says the middle is empty.

test.title: Junction 101 builds drivable
test.failLog: turn%(s%) we laid cannot be driven
test.hint: Then build 101 with a 3-6 m turn radius: 4 turns to and from the south track, no two points on one spot, the west to north-east track still runs through, and the route check is clean.

test.title: The built 101 clears again
test.hint: Clear 101 once more: the turns go, the card says the middle is empty, and nothing else is touched. Undo brings the turns back.

test.title: Builds come out drivable
test.passLog: AutoDrive can take through here, all of them turns we meant
test.failLog: turn%(s%) we laid cannot be driven
test.hint: Build a few other junctions too. Ticks itself: pass on a clean route check, fail if any build says a turn cannot be driven.

test.title: Two trucks share a junction without trouble
test.hint: On a junction you just built or placed, send two AutoDrive trucks through at the same time on crossing or merging routes: one waits, the other goes, no crash, nobody stuck. Try it a few times with different timing.

test.title: A save keeps the split
test.hint: Change a split decision, save the game, reload: the decision is still there.
